{{Quote|Those must be the Needles. The center of the Jundland Wastes. Tusken Country -- the lair of the Sand People...|[[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 9">[[Star Wars (1998) 9|''Star Wars'' (1998) 9]]</ref>}}
'''The Needles''', or '''Needles Range''', was a section that marked the center of the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] by two large rock formations jutting upwards from the desert. Many [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] clans of twenty to thirty individuals returned annually to their traditional encampments in the Needles to wait out the dangerous sandstorm season.

According to information accessed by [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] during his search for the wayward [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Sharad Hett]] on Tatooine, no outsider has entered the Needles since the time of the bandit known as [[Alkhara/Legends|Alkhara]]. Ki-Adi-Mundi and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] both entered the mountains in pursuit of Hett, and found themselves fighting off packs of deadly [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]].

For a time, a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragon]] inhabited one of the mountains and laid a clutch of eggs in one of its caverns. This beast was later slain by Sharad Hett's son, [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad]], during his test to become a full member of their Tusken clan.
